column1: # Stage checklists, one row per box. kind: file (path exists), placeholder (file|text that must be gone; a missing file counts as gone), contains (file|text that must be there), setting (endpoint|jq that prints true or false), ci (latest check runs on the default branch pass), site (website answers), cran (package is on CRAN), platforms (the file's platforms line names windows/ and macos/), description (DESCRIPTION's Description says more than its Title), group (a parent box: ticked when every box under it is ticked), manual (a person ticks it).

# id is the box's permanent name in the issue. release: any (every package), cran (left out for internal packages) or qc (only when the package chose the QC checklist; these boxes are the QC sections of Next release). needs: a path the package must have for the box to appear. where, link and pick: the settings page, its address ({repo}, {owner}, {branch}, {package}, {version} are filled in) and the value to choose.

# parent: the id of the box this one sits under (one level; the parent is earlier in the file, in the same stage and section; a box whose parent is left out is left out too). optional: yes for a box that does not hold the list open: the list closes when every other box is ticked.
# Keep every row at 13 tab-separated cells, and no hash sign inside a cell (lists treat it as a comment).
